name: Pallavi Vichare
player_statement:
A complete player, Pallavi Vichare has made a big mark in cricket. With 11 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 24*, with an average of 10.67 and a quick strike rate of 84.21. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 4 sixes and 3 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 13.0 overs, taking 8 wickets at an economy rate of 5.69. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
